_: The cast: Meshy characters (CC0, Meshy community; ~/code/goc-kits/meshy, verdicts in docs/research/meshy-cast.md) brought in as our townsfolk's bodies by realm/tools/cast_import.py (Blender on the CPU: Mixamo bones renamed to our map, its own clips dropped, textures capped at 1024 px, a cloth mask). on: the switch (--cast=meshy, or on here; --cast=kit the bodies and outfits as before). members: each body by its folder under realm/assets/people/mixamo (cast_<name>): sex, the roles it plays (people.gd's stations: peasant, townsfolk, soldier, noble, knight, clergy; the roles' places are villagers.gd's and works.gd's), and mask: its cloth mask (the cloth that takes a dye: the town's dyes for townsfolk, the house's colour for a soldier). A role a cast member covers is played by the cast alone.
